title: I threw cakes, robbed banks, and stomped a monarch in Claire a la Mode
description: This faster paced sequel to Curse Crackers requires no prior knowledge to enjoy. The game has three full unique storylines, each with five unique stages, and 2-3 playable characters. I really enjoyed the size and exeuction of almost everything in the game. The moment to moment gameplay reminded me of Kirby games of yore.
